name: Distro 10 - 1.2g Injected Pre Roll - Bubba Burst
description:
Big flavor, extra kick. The Distro 10 Bubba Burst pre-roll is a 1.2-gram infused joint, packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Built on the Bubba Burger strain, Bubba Burst brings a rich, savory-gassy profile: deep earthy kush notes up front with a funky, cheesy edge and a smooth, subtly sweet finish. As a hybrid, it lands balanced and easygoing — a mellow, feel-good calm that settles the body while keeping a gentle lift, making it a versatile pick for winding down or kicking back any time of day.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes for extra potency
Bubba Burger strain — savory, gassy kush with a funky, earthy backbone
Balanced hybrid effects — mellow and easygoing, great any time of day
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke joint. Distro 10 Bubba Burst is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
